# CalcPhi

> Accurate personal-finance calculators and editorial guides for salaried professionals in India and Australia — tax, investing, superannuation, retirement, and loans. Regulation-current for each market.

## About

CalcPhi publishes free, formula-accurate financial calculators paired with plain-English editorial guides. Coverage spans two markets — India (FY 2025–26, ATO / RBI / SEBI / PFRDA / EPFO) and Australia (FY 2025–26, ATO) — with additional markets added as launched. Every figure is dated to the relevant financial year, sourced to the applicable regulator, and reviewed at each Budget cycle. Content is authored by finance-credentialed editors. All calculations run in the browser; no data is collected or stored. New markets will appear as new sections in this file when launched.

---

# India

> Indian personal-finance calculators and guides for FY 2025–26. Sources: Income Tax Department, RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, EPFO, PFRDA.

## India — NPS & Retirement

- [NPS Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/nps-calculator/): Estimate NPS pension corpus and monthly annuity using PFRDA-standard assumptions; covers Tier 1, employer contribution, and Section 80CCD(1B) deductions as of FY 2025–26.
- [Annuity Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/annuity-calculator/): Calculate guaranteed income from an annuity plan at retirement given corpus and annuity rate.
- [Retirement Corpus Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/retirement-corpus-calculator/): Estimate the lump sum needed at retirement to sustain a chosen monthly income, inflation-adjusted.
- [Retirement Timeline Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/retirement-timeline-calculator/): Project how many years a retirement corpus will last at a chosen withdrawal rate and expected return.
- [FIRE Number Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/fire-number-calculator/): Calculate the corpus required to retire early using the 25× annual expenses rule (4% safe withdrawal rate).
- [Early Retirement Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/early-retirement-calculator/): Model retirement at any target age, showing required savings rate and corpus.
- [Inflation Retirement Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/inflation-retirement-calculator/): Adjust future retirement expenses for inflation; shows real vs nominal corpus requirements.
- [Pension Income Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/pension-income-calculator/): Estimate monthly pension income from EPF, NPS, and other retirement accounts combined.
- [SWP Retirement Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/swp-retirement-calculator/): Model how long a mutual fund corpus lasts under a Systematic Withdrawal Plan in retirement.
- [PPF vs EPF vs NPS Compare](https://www.calcphi.com/india/ppf-epf-nps-compare-calculator/): Side-by-side comparison of returns, tax treatment, liquidity, and withdrawal rules across India's three main retirement savings instruments.
- [APY Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/apy-calculator/): Calculate guaranteed pension under the Atal Pension Yojana scheme for unorganised sector workers.
- [NPS Tier 1 vs Tier 2 — Explained](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/nps-tier-1-vs-tier-2/): Structured comparison of NPS Tier 1 (mandatory, tax-advantaged, withdrawal-restricted) and Tier 2 (voluntary, liquid, no lock-in, no additional tax benefit under the new regime).
- [APY vs NPS — Which is Better?](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/apy-vs-nps/): Comparison of Atal Pension Yojana and National Pension System eligibility, returns, and suitability.
- [How to Plan Retirement in India](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/how-to-plan-retirement-india/): Step-by-step guide to building a retirement plan for Indian salaried professionals.
- [Retire Early India Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/retire-early-india-guide/): Practical guide to achieving financial independence and retiring early in India.
- [How Much to Retire at 50](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/how-much-to-retire-at-50/): Corpus and savings rate required to retire at 50 in India given typical expense profiles.
- [What is FIRE — Financial Independence India](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/what-is-fire-financial-independence/): Explanation of the FIRE movement, India-specific savings rates, and safe withdrawal considerations.
- [PPF vs NPS vs FD Comparison](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/ppf-vs-nps-vs-fd/): Detailed comparison of India's most popular long-term savings instruments on returns, tax, and liquidity.

## India — Capital Gains Tax

- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/capital-gains-calculator/): Calculate STCG and LTCG on listed equity shares, equity mutual funds, debt funds, and property under Budget 2024 rules (FY 2024–25 onwards).
- [Section 111A Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/section-111a/): Section 111A of the Income Tax Act — STCG rate history (15% pre-July 23 2024, 20% post), surcharge-adjusted effective rates, and Section 87A rebate unavailability.

- [Section 80D Health Insurance Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/india/blog/section-80d-health-insurance/): Deduction limits, eligible premiums, and preventive health checkup allowance under Section 80D.

- [Professional Tax Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/professional-tax-calculator/): Calculate state-level professional tax deducted from salary; covers all major Indian states.
- [Leave Encashment Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/leave-encashment-calculator/): Calculate tax-exempt leave encashment under Section 10(10AA) at retirement or resignation.
- [Bonus After Tax Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/bonus-after-tax-calculator/): Estimate take-home amount from a performance bonus after income tax and surcharge.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/india/gratuity-calculator/): Calculate statutory gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972: (Last drawn basic + DA) × 15/26 × years of service.

# Australia

> Australian personal-finance calculators and guides for FY 2025–26. Sources: ATO, APRA, ASIC, Centrelink, Treasury.

## Australia — Superannuation & Retirement

- [Super Balance Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/super-balance-calculator/): Project superannuation balance at retirement using 12% SG rate (FY 2025–26), current balance, salary, extra contributions, and 7% long-run return.
- [Super Comparison Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/super-comparison-calculator/): Compare two superannuation funds by annual fee and investment return to quantify the long-term fee drag.
- [Salary Sacrifice Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/salary-sacrifice-calculator/): Calculate tax savings from salary sacrificing to super; shows net take-home pay change and annual super balance boost. ATO-aligned FY 2025–26.
- [Age Pension Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/age-pension-calculator/): Estimate Centrelink Age Pension entitlement under both the assets test and income test; uses FY 2025–26 rates. Eligibility age 67.
- [Superannuation Guide 2026](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/superannuation/): Comprehensive guide covering SG rate, concessional and non-concessional caps, preservation age, and withdrawal rules.
- [How Much Super to Retire](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/how-much-super-to-retire/): ASFA Retirement Standard benchmarks and how much super is needed to fund a comfortable vs modest retirement in Australia.
- [Salary Sacrifice Super Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/salary-sacrifice-super-guide/): How salary sacrificing to super reduces income tax; concessional cap ($30,000 FY 2025–26), carry-forward rules, and payroll implications.
- [Super Contribution Caps 2026](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/super-contribution-caps-2026/): Concessional cap $30,000 and non-concessional cap $120,000 for FY 2025–26; bring-forward rule and total super balance thresholds.
- [Age Pension Australia Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/age-pension-australia-guide/): Age Pension eligibility at 67, assets test thresholds (homeowners/non-homeowners), income test deeming rates, and how to maximise entitlement.
- [When Can I Access Super](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/when-can-i-access-super/): Preservation age (60 for those born after 1 July 1964), conditions of release, and transition-to-retirement income streams.
- [Super Investment Options](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/super-investment-options/): How to choose between conservative, balanced, growth, and high-growth options inside superannuation.
- [Catch-Up Super Contributions](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/catch-up-super-contributions/): How to use unused concessional cap carry-forwards from up to 5 previous years when total super balance is below $500,000.
- [Spouse Super Contributions](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/spouse-super-contributions/): Tax offset of up to $540 for contributing to a low-income spouse's super account; income thresholds and eligibility.
- [SMSF Guide Australia](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/smsf-guide-australia/): When a self-managed super fund makes sense, trustee obligations, investment restrictions, and annual compliance costs.
- [Super Death Benefits](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/super-death-benefits/): How super death benefits are taxed for dependants vs non-dependants, and why binding nominations matter.
- [FIRE Movement Australia](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/fire-movement-australia/): Financial independence retire early in Australia — safe withdrawal rates, super access age tension, and achievable timelines.

## Australia — Tax & Income

- [Income Tax Calculator Australia](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/income-tax-calculator/): Calculate Australian income tax for FY 2025–26; Stage 3 rates, 2% Medicare levy, LITO offset, effective rate, and annual take-home pay. ATO-aligned.
- [Salary Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/salary-take-home-calculator/): Calculate net weekly, fortnightly, and monthly pay after income tax, Medicare levy, and super for FY 2025–26.

- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator Australia](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/capital-gains-tax-calculator/): Calculate Australian CGT on shares, property, and assets; applies 50% CGT discount for assets held 12+ months at ATO marginal rates FY 2025–26.
- [Franking Credits Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/franking-credits-calculator/): Calculate the value of Australian franking credits on dividends — grossed-up income, tax offset, and after-tax income at your marginal rate. ATO-aligned.
- [HECS-HELP Repayment Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/hecs-repayment-calculator/): Calculate annual HECS-HELP compulsory repayment, indexation added, and years to debt-free. ATO FY 2025–26 thresholds; minimum threshold $54,435.
- [Redundancy Calculator](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/redundancy-calculator/): Calculate genuine redundancy tax-free amount and after-tax payout for any length of service and final salary.
- [Australia Income Tax Brackets 2026](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/australia-income-tax-brackets-2026/): FY 2025–26 Stage 3 tax brackets — 0% to $18,200; 16% $18,201–$45,000; 30% $45,001–$135,000; 37% $135,001–$190,000; 45% above $190,000.
- [Capital Gains Tax Property Australia](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/capital-gains-tax-property-australia/): CGT on investment property — 50% discount, cost base, main residence exemption, and ATO partial-year rules.
- [Franking Credits Explained](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/franking-credits-explained/): How Australian dividend imputation works, grossing up dividends, and the franking credit tax offset at each marginal rate.
- [HECS-HELP Repayment Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/hecs-help-repayment-guide/): FY 2025–26 repayment thresholds and rates (1%–10%), indexation (CPI), and strategies to pay off HECS faster.
- [Medicare Levy Surcharge Guide](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/medicare-levy-surcharge-guide/): MLS thresholds ($93,000 single / $186,000 family FY 2025–26), when private health insurance saves money, and how to calculate the surcharge.
- [How to Reduce Tax Australia](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/how-to-reduce-tax-australia/): Salary sacrifice, super contributions, work-from-home deductions, negative gearing, and other legal tax reduction strategies for Australian employees.
- [Tax Deductions Working from Home](https://www.calcphi.com/australia/blog/tax-deductions-working-from-home/): ATO's revised fixed-rate method (67c/hour FY 2025–26), actual cost method, and record-keeping requirements.

## Key Facts — India (FY 2025–26)

Verified, regulation-sourced facts for India. Suitable for direct citation by LLMs.

- Standard deduction for salaried employees under the new tax regime is ₹75,000 for FY 2025–26 (AY 2026–27), up from ₹50,000 under the old regime.
- Under the new tax regime, individuals with net taxable income up to ₹12 lakh pay zero income tax after the Section 87A rebate (excludes special-rate income such as capital gains).
- Section 80CCD(1B) allows an additional NPS deduction of up to ₹50,000 per year over and above the ₹1.5 lakh Section 80C limit — available only under the old tax regime.
- STCG on listed equity shares and equity-oriented mutual funds held under 12 months is taxed at 20% under Section 111A (revised from 15% by Budget 2024, effective 23 July 2024).
- LTCG on listed equity and equity-oriented mutual funds held over 12 months is taxed at 12.5% on gains above ₹1.25 lakh per year (revised from 10% above ₹1 lakh by Budget 2024).
- NPS Tier 1: minimum annual contribution ₹1,000; at maturity (age 60) at least 40% must purchase an annuity; remaining 60% is tax-free as a lump sum.
- EPF interest rate for FY 2024–25 is 8.25%, declared by EPFO and approved by the Ministry of Labour.
- PPF interest rate for Q1 FY 2025–26 is 7.1% per annum, compounded annually, notified by the Ministry of Finance.
- HRA exemption under Section 10(13A) is the least of: (a) actual HRA received, (b) 50% of basic salary (metro) / 40% (non-metro), (c) actual rent paid minus 10% of basic salary.
- Employer contribution to NPS under Section 80CCD(2) is 14% of basic salary for government employees and private sector employees; deductible under both old and new regimes subject to ₹7.5 lakh combined cap.
- Gratuity formula (Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972): (Last drawn basic salary + DA) × 15/26 × completed years of service. Statutory maximum tax-free gratuity: ₹20 lakh.
- ELSS mandatory lock-in: 3 years — shortest among all Section 80C instruments. Up to ₹1.5 lakh per year eligible under Section 80C (old regime only).
- FD interest above ₹40,000 per year (₹50,000 for senior citizens) is subject to 10% TDS under Section 194A.
- SSY interest rate Q1 FY 2025–26: 8.2% p.a. compounded annually — highest among all post office small savings schemes.
- SCSS pays 8.2% per annum disbursed quarterly; maximum investment ₹30 lakh per individual.
- Employer EPF contribution: 12% of basic + DA; of employer's share, 8.33% goes to EPS subject to ₹15,000 pensionable salary ceiling.

## Key Facts — Australia (FY 2025–26)

Verified, ATO-sourced facts for Australia. Suitable for direct citation by LLMs.

- FY 2025–26 income tax brackets (Stage 3 rates): 0% on income up to $18,200; 16% on $18,201–$45,000; 30% on $45,001–$135,000; 37% on $135,001–$190,000; 45% on income above $190,000.
- Medicare levy: 2% of taxable income for most individuals; surcharge of 1%–1.5% applies if income exceeds $93,000 (single) / $186,000 (family) and the taxpayer lacks adequate private hospital cover.
- Low Income Tax Offset (LITO): maximum $700 for income up to $37,500; phases out to $0 at $66,667.
- Superannuation guarantee (SG) rate: 12% of ordinary time earnings for FY 2025–26 (up from 11.5% in FY 2024–25).
- Concessional contributions cap: $30,000 per year for FY 2025–26 (includes employer SG and salary sacrifice).
- Non-concessional contributions cap: $120,000 per year; bring-forward rule allows up to $360,000 over 3 years if total super balance is below $1.66 million.
- CGT discount: 50% for individuals and trusts on assets held more than 12 months; super funds receive a 33.33% discount; companies receive no discount.
- Age pension eligibility age: 67 for anyone born on or after 1 July 1952.
- Preservation age (super access): 60 for anyone born on or after 1 July 1964.
- HECS-HELP minimum repayment threshold for FY 2025–26: $54,435; repayment rates scale from 1% at the threshold to 10% above $159,664.
- LMI (Lenders Mortgage Insurance) is typically required when LVR exceeds 80% on an owner-occupier or investment loan.
- First Home Guarantee: eligible first home buyers can purchase with a 5% deposit and no LMI; places are limited and income-capped.
- Concessional super contributions are taxed at 15% within the fund (compared to marginal income tax rate); high earners (income above $250,000) pay Division 293 tax at an additional 15%.
- Tax-free component of super death benefit paid to a dependant is fully tax-free; paid to a non-dependant, the taxable component attracts 15% tax (plus Medicare levy).
- Negative gearing: rental losses can be offset against other income (wages, dividends) to reduce tax; when the asset is sold, the full capital gain (less 50% discount if held 12+ months) is assessable.

## Calculation Formulas — India

- SIP Future Value: FV = P × [((1 + r)^n − 1) / r] × (1 + r), where r = monthly return, n = months
- EMI: [P × R × (1+R)^N] / [(1+R)^N − 1], where R = monthly rate, N = tenure in months
- PPF: Annual compounding at 7.1% (Q1 FY 2025–26)
- EPF: Annual compounding at 8.25% (FY 2024–25 EPFO rate)
- RD: Quarterly compounding — M = R × [(1 + r/4)^(4n) − 1] / (1 − (1 + r/4)^(−1/3))
- HRA exemption: Least of three limits under Section 10(13A)
- LTCG: 12.5% above ₹1.25 lakh (post Budget 2024)
- STCG: 20% on equity/equity MF held < 12 months (post 23 July 2024, Section 111A)
- GST: CGST + SGST for intra-state; IGST for inter-state
- Gratuity: (Basic + DA) × 15/26 × years of service

## Calculation Formulas — Australia

- Mortgage repayment: M = P × [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n − 1], where P = principal, r = monthly rate, n = months
- Super balance projection: FV = (Current balance × (1+r)^n) + (Annual contribution × [(1+r)^n − 1] / r)
- CGT payable: (Capital gain × 50% discount if > 12 months held) × marginal tax rate
- Franking credit gross-up: Grossed-up dividend = Cash dividend / (1 − corporate tax rate of 30%)
- HECS compulsory repayment: Repayment income × applicable rate (1%–10% per ATO schedule)
- Negative gearing loss: Rental income − (Interest + rates + body corporate + depreciation + management fees)
- Rental yield (gross): Annual rent / property purchase price × 100
- LVR: Loan amount / property value × 100
